Phase 3B must not be scheduled until the room-binding question has an upstream answer.

classification.reason: Frame encoding, canonical JSON, offer ids and contract ids are byte-identical across the two trees. One existing transition changed: applyFrame now refuses a lock once nowMs >= refundAfterMs (#43). That is a tightening, not a wire break, and it is fully attributed to a single upstream commit. Blackbox stays pinned at 81a8346 until the affected fixture is re-authored to a lawful lock time, so no accepted Phase 2/2.1 replay fingerprint changes under our feet.
